title: Theme
description: The entire visual identity of the site. Pick a preset name and, optionally, nudge a small number of overrides on top of it. Never add a colour here beyond colors.accent — every other colour lives in src/theme/presets and is chosen by preset name only.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, for editor autocomplete. Not used at runtime.

preset.description: The named colour identity for the whole site. 'darkroom' (default): warm bronze accent on near-black. 'marquee': printed-playbill cream and red. 'screen-test': black and white, no accent colour. 'green-room': backstage green with a brass accent.

colors.description: The only place a raw colour may be typed outside src/theme/presets. Leave this out entirely unless you specifically need to shift the accent colour away from the preset's default.

accent.description: Overrides the preset's accent colour (used for links, highlights, and call-to-action text). Must be a 6-digit hex code, e.g. "#B08A3E". The text colour used on top of this accent is chosen automatically for contrast.

typePair.description: Which pair of typefaces to use for headings and body text. 'bodoni-plex' (default): Bodoni Moda display + IBM Plex Sans body. 'fraunces-inter': Fraunces display + Inter body. 'archivo-archivo': Archivo Expanded display + Archivo body. 'spectral-plex': Spectral display + IBM Plex Sans body. Only the selected pairing is downloaded by visitors.

radius.description: How rounded corners are across the site, from photo frames to buttons. 'sharp': square corners. 'soft' (default): a small, modern rounding. 'round': pronounced rounded corners.

density.description: How much breathing room sits between sections and elements. 'compact': tighter spacing, more fits on screen. 'comfortable' (default): balanced spacing. 'spacious': generous, editorial whitespace.

motion.description: Global multiplier for animation and transition intensity, from 0 (no motion at all) to 1 (full motion, the default). Visitors who have 'reduce motion' turned on in their operating system always get 0, regardless of this setting.
